root: ^A dark, stuffy room. Uncomfortably hot.[WAFI] A dreamless sleep fell away from my mind as I slowly remembered that I was alive.[WAFI] Thoughts manifested of something important, so important, to which attending was far more important than any rest.

g-0: ^I NEED to scroll short videos on my phone.[WAFI][CLER]

^I open my eyes. Laying upon my girlfriend's no-doubt long dead arm, I grab my phone from next to me on the pillowcase and unlock it in a swift, well-practiced motion (a number password: the release date of my favourite film).[WAFI] I am confronted with, opened up to, the endless possibility of "phone". I know what I must do next.[WAFI]
^Low volume, so as to not wake my sleeping pillow. Low brightness, perfectly adjusted for bed-time scrolling. App already open, ensuring total efficiency.
g-1: ^I scroll down, my first short video already in sight. It's a small NYC-based comedy group I follow, "smelly freak".[WAFI] In this sketch, the gay one is playing an elderly Italian man, and the woman his son.[WAFI] They want to get into a bodega, but there is an anti-Italian barrier.[WAFI] The video is 6 minutes long.[WAFI] It's New York, it's elevated. Other people would not understand. I do, because I visited New York when I was 14, and I watch a lot of videos. Excellent.
g-2: ^I scroll again. It's a video of two incredibly attractive goth women making out.[WAFI] It has been reposted by an annoying woman I met in college who I still nontheless follow.[WAFI] This is so normalized for me that I do not consider unfollowing her.
g-3: ^My endless march continues. It goes on for quite a while. Under me, the arm I'm resting on begins to twitch a bit, so I lift up slightly, and it slowly slinks back to Alice-Rose's body.[WAFI][CLER]
^"Babe" she mutters. On my phone is a video of a Chinese woman advertising heavy industrial machinery for food processing.[WAFI]
^"Yes?" I respond, attentatively. Attentively? I wonder what kind of person buys industrial food processing equipment they see while scrolling their phone.[WAFI]
g-4: ^There's this band Alice-Rose really likes. Suck the Count. No, Stop the Count. It's Stop the Count.[WAFI] They're an awful online scene band from many years ago that nerds really like whose music, in addition to being deeply misogynistic, is also awful.[WAFI] When she first played it for me she laughed so hard because she could see my face slowly drop as I realised how bad they are.[WAFI] Anyway, we went to uni with a couple girls whose band - saygoodbyeyesterday - is opening for them.[WAFI] They were hyped about it, somehow, and they invited us, so that's what we're doing today.[WAFI]

^I scroll to the next video.[WAFI] It's a man covered in green paint, ordering at a restaurant.[WAFI] This is his gimmick, he's green and does things in public.[WAFI] It's New York, it's elevated.[WAFI]
^"Yeah, it's today." I say, regarding the nature of today being the thing.[WAFI]
^"I'm gonna shower. Could you make breakfast?"[WAFI]
g-5: ^I roll over to face her. Why is she showering before breakfast?[WAFI]
^"Why are you showering before breakfast?"  I ask.[WAFI]
^"It's like, I'm really excited. So I want it to be a clean day."[WAFI]
^"Wouldn't it still be a clean day if you shower later? And you're going to be wet. There'll be crumbs"[WAFI]
g-6: ^"Whatever," she says, visibly a bit irritated. "It's just the way I've always done things like this. I'm excited."[WAFI]
^I shrug and say "alright, whatever. I'll get out of bed in a sec" before rolling back over.[WAFI]

^Alice-Rose walks off to the shower, with a pace of walking that implies that she's somewhat irritated with me. Were I stupid, I would bring it up, but the baby knows not to rock the cradle.[WAFI] I quickly look up whether that's a saying.[WAFI][CLER]
^Some time passes, but I'm still on my phone.

c-7: ^I think about getting up to make breakfast.

c-0: ^I groan and roll over. I really do know I should get up.
^I roll over again, throwing myself off of the bed and onto the floor. I use the mental momentum to move to the kitchen.[WAFI]

g-7: ^Unfortunately, the magnetic allure of short-form video content pulls me back in.[WAFI]

reels: ^This time, the green man is joined by a blue woman. I click her profile to see whether she is always blue, or is just doing a bit for this video. In New York, things like these aren't a given.[WAFI] She does appear to make videos where she is blue. That's fascinating.[WAFI] As I keep scrolling her profile, I hear the sound of the shower being turned off.

g-0: ^The instant burst of energy granted by knowing that I am, factually speaking, a moron fills me with the momentum to leap out of bread.[WAFI] I mean bed.[WAFI] I swiftly walk to the kitchen and put four slices of bread into the toaster.[WAFI] I hear footsteps behind me.
